LanguageData.RUT_GreatboleShaking: The Great Shaking! The greatbole answers its wounds — fruit and grubs come down from the canopy, and the chambers within shudder.
LanguageData.RUT_GreatboleViolentHealing: The greatbole is closing on you. Past this point it heals faster than anyone can mine — get clear, or seal what you mean to keep.
LanguageData.RUT_GreatboleCatastrophe: The greatbole falls. Huge trunk segments crash down for fifty cells around it, crushing everything in their path. It will never heal, never fruit, and never sing again.
LanguageData.RUT_GreatboleFruitfallText: A greatbole has dropped ripe fruit of its own accord — and, with it, a few grubs come to feed. No wound, no wound at all: the tree gave this freely.
